title: Oliver Sacks' autistic twins who traded six-digit prime numbers

tellings.quote: one of the case reports were about these twins who are institutionalized who were autistic who played a game in which they would say prime numbers back and forth to one another

plain: Twin brothers who were autistic and lived in an institution are said to have played a game of saying large prime numbers, up to six digits, back and forth to each other. The researcher Diane Powell repeats this as a case report by the neurologist Oliver Sacks, linking it to his book Awakenings. If true, it would suggest the twins shared knowledge in a way no one could explain.
